subject: Getting runtime error (Can't call `runApp()` from within `runApp()`.)

messages.author: 65e83e7722011a8f
messages.subject: Getting runtime error (Can't call `runApp()` from within `runApp()`.)
parts:
My Shiny app works fine locally, but as soon I deployed it I got the following error:
ERROR: Can't call `runApp()` from within `runApp()`. If your ,application code contains `runApp()`, please remove it.

If I remove the runApp() function my app fails to work entirely, as I would expect. How do i get around this?

messages.author: d6ebe55625e8e5a2
messages.subject: Re: Getting runtime error (Can't call `runApp()` from within `runApp()`.)
parts:
Is your app something like:

ui <- fluidPage(...)
server <- function(input, output) {...}

app <- shinyApp(ui, server)

runApp(app)

If so, you should change it into:

ui <- fluidPage(...)
server <- function(input, output) {...}

shinyApp(ui, server)

If not, could you please post a minimal reproducible example?
